<fidel-described-image>

Diagram with a full description. A <figure> with alt text, a caption and a "Full description" that opens under the image.

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Blind learners, and anyone who finds a diagram hard to read.

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት።

Three boxes in a row: Browser, Server, Database.

  1. The browser sends a request to the server.
  2. The server asks the database for the data it needs.
  3. The database sends the data back, and the server sends a web page to the browser.

Code to copyየሚቀዳ ኮድ

<fidel-described-image src="request-flow.png" alt="How a web request travels"
                       long-description-id="flow-desc"></fidel-described-image>
<div id="flow-desc" hidden><p>The browser sends a request to the server…</p></div>

Source: player/src/components/a/described-image.js

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-described-image>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
srcURLnone (required)The image.
alttextnone (required)Short text alternative. Missing alt gives a console warning, never the file name.
captiontextthe alt textVisible caption.
long-description-ididnoneId of an element (usually hidden) whose content is the full description.
descriptiontextnoneOr: the full description as plain text.
width, heightpixelsnoneImage size, so the page does not jump while it loads.
show-warningsbooleanoffShows a visible "no alt text" warning (for authoring pages).
ui-langen, amthe page's lang, else enLanguage of the component's own buttons and messages.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

None.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • "Full description" is a native <details>: Enter or Space opens it.
  • The image is read by its alt text and caption; the description is real text with lists and headings.

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Its own buttons and messages are in English or Amharic. Set ui-lang="am" on the tag (or on a parent); without it, the page's lang is used, else English.

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 1.1.1 Non-text Content: Always has alt (empty plus a warning if the author forgot it) and a long description in real text.
  • 1.3.1 Info and Relationships: Real <figure>, <figcaption> and <details>.

The full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report
